## GrabAGun to Present and Host 1x1 Investor Meetings at the 18th Annual Southwest IDEAS Investor Conference in Dallas, TX on November 18th


November 17, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/956379955/files/doc_news/GrabAGun-to-Present-and-Host-1x1-Investor-Meetings-at-the-18th-Annual-Southwest-IDEAS-Investor-Conference-in-Dallas-TX-on-November-18th-2026.pdf)


COPPELL, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PEW), a technology-driven commerce, distribution, and logistics company serving the firearms, ammunition, and outdoor industry, today announced that Chief Executive Officer, Marc Nemati and Chief Financial Officer, Jonathan Terry will present at the 18th Annual Southwest IDEAS Investor Conference on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at The Westin Convention Center at Las Colinas in Dallas, TX. The Company’s presentation is scheduled to begin at 3:20 pm CT. The presentation will be webcast and can be accessed through the conference host’s main website:[https://www.threepartadvisors.com/southwest](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.threepartadvisors.com%2Fsouthwest&esheet=54642484&newsitemid=20261117937515&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.threepartadvisors.com%2Fsouthwest&index=1&md5=0bf0141ca6bc1d5ade922e48af495aa0) and in the investor relations section of the company's website:[https://investors.grabagun.com/events-and-presentations.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.grabagun.com%2Fevents-and-presentations.%2520&esheet=54642484&newsitemid=20261117937515&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.grabagun.com%2Fevents-and-presentations.&index=2&md5=c16be2549500b3ef181873aab9afbe07)


**About IDEAS Investor Conferences**


The IDEAS Investor Conferences are held annually and produced by Three Part Advisors, LLC. The mission of the IDEAS Conferences is to provide independent regional venues for quality companies to present their investment merits to an influential audience of investment professionals. Unlike traditional bank-sponsored events, IDEAS Investor Conferences are “SPONSORED BY INVESTORS. FOR INVESTORS.” and for the benefit of regional investment communities. Conference sponsors collectively have more than $200 billion in assets under management and additional information can be found at[www.IDEASconferences.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ideasconferences.com%2F&esheet=54642484&newsitemid=20261117937515&lan=en-US&anchor=www.IDEASconferences.com&index=3&md5=0bfb0e679394ba7c57519d2ee1027309) . If interested in participating or learning more about the IDEAS conferences, please contact Lacey Wesley atlWesley@IDEASconferences.com .


**About GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc.**


GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (NYSE: PEW) is a technology-driven commerce, distribution, and logistics company serving the firearms, ammunition, and outdoor industry. The Company operates across three complementary capabilities: digital retail through GrabAGun.com, operated by its wholly-owned subsidiary GrabAGun LLC; wholesale distribution through its wholly-owned subsidiary Camfour LLC; and manufacturer logistics and platform services through its wholly-owned subsidiary PEW Logistics LLC. GrabAGun.com is one of the nation’s leading online firearms retailers, built on 16 years of proprietary technology spanning inventory and order management, pricing, demand forecasting, and regulatory compliance. PEW Logistics provides manufacturers with technology-enabled fulfillment, compliance, data, marketing, and direct-to-consumer capabilities. Together with Camfour, these separately operated businesses connect manufacturers, independent dealers, and consumers, with a goal of improving product access, distribution efficiency, and industry connectivity. For more information, visit[investors.grabagun.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.grabagun.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54642484&newsitemid=20261117937515&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.grabagun.com&index=4&md5=70ee3c91617b1f19e6db2892bde92ef1) .
